f5bdfae650728f39.description: About Nestlé Nestlé is the world's largest food and beverage company. The organization is driven by a purpose to enhance the quality of life and contribute to a healthier future through its passionate people and human-centric environment. Role Overview Nestlé is seeking an Associate Manager, Sales to join the team in Jeddah. This full-time role focuses on achieving sales targets by category, maximizing growth opportunities, and building long-term customer relationships. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Achieve area sales growth targets by category. Meet core distribution (new Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) listing), picture of success targets, and agreed visibility elements in the Business Development Agreement (BDA). Develop strong customer relationships and initiate contract negotiations (visibility, shelf space, promotions, and implementations). Organize daily field visits and follow up with stores in the assigned area to ensure product availability. Report market intelligence (sales analysis, monthly initiative implementations, competitor activities, launches, customer plans, and shopper profiles) to sales management. Ensure effective and efficient implementation of the promotional plan in stores within the assigned area(s). Ensure on-shelf availability of all products based on core distribution by communicating with merchandisers and conducting store visits. Ensure collection and financial reconciliation are made in line with Nestlé's set payment terms. Follow up with merchandisers on their daily journey plan and resolve any arising issues. Provide constructive feedback on stock handling and product implementation on shelves, checkouts, secondary placements, and gondolas. Compliance and Ethical Standards Ensure strict adherence and compliance on all activities, including those taking place on trade, to the WHO International Code of Marketing of Breast-Milk Substitutes and Nestlé Instructions and local country codes. f5ef86c70a9759b4.description: About ALPLA Group ALPLA Group is seeking a Manufacturing Manager to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role involves managing personnel, optimizing production metrics, and implementing maintenance procedures to support overall plant profitability. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily production plans, schedule personnel, and ensure target output is met. Optimize cycle times, material usage, and implement waste reduction strategies. Conduct 5S assessments, GMP audits, risk evaluations, and Gemba walks to enforce safety standards and company policies. Assist the Head of Operations in budget preparation and support overall plant efficiency and profitability initiatives. f571b0cc1271aa3e.description: A contracting company in Saudi Arabia is seeking a highly experienced Senior Microtunneling Engineer to lead and supervise microtunneling and pipe jacking operations for infrastructure projects. Key Responsibilities: 1. Microtunneling Operations * Plan, manage, and supervise Microtunneling (MTBM) and Pipe Jacking operations. * Oversee the preparation of launching and receiving shafts, equipment installation, and tunneling activities. * Supervise MTBM operation, pipe jacking, alignment, and guidance systems. * Monitor jacking forces, thrust pressures, friction, and tunneling performance. * Manage slurry circulation, separation systems, lubrication, and spoil removal. 2. Technical Management & Troubleshooting * Evaluate geotechnical reports, soil conditions, and groundwater levels. * Identify and resolve technical issues, including machine blockage, excessive jacking forces, and alignment deviations. * Monitor ground settlement and implement preventive measures. * Review technical drawings, method statements, and engineering calculations. * Coordinate equipment maintenance and resolve operational breakdowns. 3. Project Management & Performance * Prepare execution plans, work schedules, and daily progress reports. * Monitor tunneling productivity, equipment utilization, and operating costs. * Supervise operators, technicians, subcontractors, and site teams. * Coordinate with clients, consultants, and relevant authorities. * Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and HSE requirements. Qualifications & Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum 7 years of experience, including at least 5 years of direct experience in Microtunneling and Pipe Jacking projects. * Proven hands-on experience with Microtunnel Boring Machines (MTBM). * Experience in pipe jacking projects with pipe diameters of 800 mm or larger. * Strong knowledge of hydraulic jacking systems, guidance systems, and lubrication techniques. * Experience with slurry systems, separation plants, and spoil management. * Ability to work in various ground conditions, including soft soil, rock, mixed ground, and groundwater. * Knowledge of jacking force calculations, friction management, and tunnel alignment control. * Strong troubleshooting, leadership, and site management skills. * Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or GCC infrastructure projects is preferred. * Must have directly supervised at least three completed Microtunneling projects.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. Your Impact You will contribute to our rapidly growing procurement service line, assisting organizations in building competitive advantage through world-class purchasing and supply management capabilities. Your work will be centered on creating sustainable impact, which is the key metric by which we measure our success. You will engage in end-to-end optimization efforts aimed at total value capture. This includes activities such as strategic sourcing, global sourcing, supplier collaboration and innovation, procure-to-pay processes, organization design, and capability building. Your contributions will span a variety of industry sectors, with a particular focus on Banking & Financial Services, Basic Materials, Consumer Goods, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, and Travel, Transport & Logistics. Your Qualifications and Skills Bachelor's degree in engineering/technology; master's degree preferred, MBA in operations advantageous 3+ years of experience in procurement or consulting Expertise in the following areas: sourcing, supplier management, category management, costing, negotiations and PO management Experience with e-procurement tools (spend analysis, RFQ tools, costing, eAuctions) is advantageous Proficient in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and relevant analytics/statistical software Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; ability to identify root causes and solutions Solid business knowledge and understanding of economic, financial, and general business concepts Strong interpersonal skills, team player, intellectually curious, excellent communication skills

f59d0d2e6bcd0721.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سرايا طويق للمقاولات عن فني إنشاءات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الخرج. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم عمليات إنشاء الأبنية من خلال أداء الواجبات الفنية الأساسية، بما في ذلك جمع العينات ومطابقة المواصفات وتقدير الكميات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة مهندس الأبنية في إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالمعاينة ومتابعة التنفيذ وضبط الجودة. أخذ عينات من تربة موقع البناء والمواد الإنشائية والخلطات الإسمنتية، وإرسالها إلى المختبر لمطابقة المواصفات. تفقد العمل في إنشاء الأبنية أثناء الإنشاء وبعده للتأكد من مطابقة المواصفات والمعايير المطلوبة. المشاركة في قياس العمل المنجز بالتنسيق المباشر مع المهندس المشرف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الإنشاءات أو دور فني ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء الواجبات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الأبنية. معرفة بجمع العينات من تربة الموقع والمواد الإنشائية. القدرة على مطابقة المواصفات الفنية للمواد والعمل المنجز. مهارات تقدير كميات المواد والعمالة اللازمة للمشاريع. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الإنشاءات ضمن فريق شركة سرايا طويق للمقاولات في مواقع العمل بالرياض، وتحديداً في منطقة الخرج. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لدعم عمليات الإنشاء بشكل مباشر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.
